title: Prof Warren Sack Lens eval
objective: Make Jamie's recursive systems intelligence legible: finding latent social structure, grounding interpretation in sources, moving from theory to prototypes and interfaces, and building ambitious forms with collaborators.
decision: Does the portfolio show Jamie discovering structure in social and technical material and turning it into inspectable, usable forms?

scoreScale.1: The portfolio presents generic delivery activity or unsupported intellectual superlatives without inspectable systems reasoning.
scoreScale.2: Projects and tools appear, but the move from observation to model, prototype, interface, and collective use is mostly absent.
scoreScale.3: The recursive method is inferable from several projects but not named or connected across the portfolio.
scoreScale.4: A first-pass reader can see Jamie find latent structure, test it through artifacts or interfaces, make it available for collective understanding and action, and learn from situated use.
scoreScale.5: The portfolio makes an unusually coherent and defensible recursive systems practice visible across research, prototypes, interfaces, situated learning, documentation, and collaborative implementation.

deterministicChecks.description: The portfolio names and evidences recursive, source-backed, prototype-to-interface systems work without unsupported genius claims.
The social-software and method framing remains source-positioned and bounded.
The lens does not expose protected student records or private correspondence.
The Warren Sack Lens revision passes the complete production preflight.

criteria.name: Prof Warren Sack Lens
criteria.question: Can a reader see Jamie recursively discover social or technical structure, support interpretation with evidence, prototype an idea, expose it through an interface or shared artifact, and carry it into collaborative use?
criteria.passDefinition: The About page names the material-to-structure method and closes the loop through learning from situated use; selected civic, community-platform, and knowledge-system work demonstrates theory-to-prototype, interface-to-use, and use-to-revision movement; sources and limits remain inspectable; and collective architectures and collaborators remain visible.
criteria.repairPolicy: Make the reasoning chain visible in the smallest correct layer: material or observation, inferred structure, prototype or artifact, interface, user action, learning from situated use, revision, and boundary. Keep project detail on its own pages.
criteria.antiGaming: Do not pass by claiming genius, publishing the phrase structural equivalence as a self-brand, listing technologies without behavior, treating source volume as insight, erasing co-design, or inventing adoption and impact.
